learning_objective: 🎯 To discover how the ancient practice of Yoga keeps our bodies fit, our minds calm, and makes us healthy from the inside out!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Yoga is not just about twisting your body into difficult shapes. It is an ancient Indian practice that uses simple postures, called Asanas, to make our muscles very strong.
When we get angry or tired, Yoga teaches us to focus on our breath. Taking slow, deep breaths, known as Pranayama, magically instantly calms our nervous system.
Doing Yoga regularly clears the clutter in our brain. It improves our memory, helps us focus better on our school studies, and keeps bad stress far away.
Yoga is a complete way of living. Waking up early, doing a few stretches like the Surya Namaskar, and eating healthy food keeps us energized all day long!

fun_activity.title: 🎭 Become a Yoga Master!
fun_activity.instructions: Try to balance on one leg like a tall tree for 30 seconds! This is called the 'Tree Pose' (Vrikshasana). Challenge your family members to try it too!

quick_recap: ⭐ Yoga is an ancient Indian tradition for holistic health.
⭐ Physical postures (Asanas) build strength and great flexibility.
⭐ Breathing exercises (Pranayama) bring instant peace and calmness.
⭐ Regular Yoga practice sharpens the mind and reduces daily stress.
